text:
olivia: Customer (acct 98765) says their refund didn't go through. They received a store credit instead. filing #CS-3448. Can someone triage?

kevin: Assigned. quick check — can you paste the api payload and the model/tool call from the logs?

olivia: pasted from support logs: ```POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Issue a refund of $42.00 to txn_abc123"}],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```
and from our tool-invocation log: ```tool_call: apply_credit({"customer_id":"98765", "amount":42, "note":"refund requested"})```

anya: looks like the model chose `apply_credit` instead of `process_refund`. schema overlap: both have `amount` + `customer_id`. our resolver uses semantic similarity + alias matching which can be ambiguous for short prompts.

sam: repro steps I used: 1) send user prompt "refund $42 for txn_abc123" 2) chat model returned JSON calling `apply_credit` 3) our call executed and created a credit memo. I can repro locally with redwood-chat-1@stable.

kevin: logs -> resolver score breakdown: apply_credit: 0.72, process_refund: 0.68. tie-breaker used alias match on keyword "credit" from training. we should avoid relying on brittle alias signals.

maria: Customer impact: payment hasn't been refunded; they flagged fraud team and asked for ETA. High priority. CS escalated.

anya: short-term mitigation: update the function signatures to prefer `process_refund` by adding a required `payment_txn_id` field (or `refund_method`) that refunds include. Also add a disambiguation prompt: "Did you mean refund (money back) or store credit?" before executing any money movement tool.

sam: alternative quick fix: set resolver override: prefer_tool: ["process_refund","apply_credit"] in the workspace routing config for payments v1. That will bump process_refund priority.

kevin: agree. I'll push a temporary override to prod for the customer account and add a rule that prompts for clarification if tools have score diff < 0.1.

deploy-bot: started config change deploy  d-445 -> rolling to payments-resolver (ETA ~2m).

ops-bot: note: added alert rule for tool_misroute_rate > 0.5% in payments namespace.

olivia: thanks team. I'll update the customer: refund scheduled once override is live. please keep me posted. :pray: 

kevin: follow-ups: (1) add explicit required arg to process_refund schema, (2) improve resolver feature to include `txn_context` token, (3) add safety confirm prompt for ambiguous payment intents. I'll open tickets and link here.

sam: filed ENG-1209 (schema disambiguation) and ENG-1210 (resolver tie-breaker tweaks). linking now.

olivia: closing internal thread after refund confirmed. will post outcome to the CS case.

maria: thanks — please mark affected customer as high-touch until we finish the safety changes.

kevin: noted, will follow up in the PR review.
